benefits.titleZh: 說明某件事為何會減低某人的成功機會
benefits.titleEn: Explain why something may reduce a person’s chance of success
benefits.zh: tell against somebody 可以表示某項弱點、錯誤或遺漏的文件對某人造成不利影響。
benefits.en: Tell against somebody is useful when a weakness, mistake or missing document puts someone at a disadvantage.

benefits.titleZh: 分辨外表或感覺相似的人和事物
benefits.titleEn: Compare people and things that look or seem similar
benefits.zh: tell apart 和 tell A from B 可以用來談論雙胞胎、相似產品、真偽物件、顏色和聲音等。
benefits.en: Tell apart and tell A from B help you talk about twins, similar products, real and fake objects, colours, sounds and many other comparisons.

benefits.titleZh: 理解報告、信件和故事中的描述
benefits.titleEn: Understand formal descriptions in reports, letters and stories
benefits.zh: tell of something 常用於表示報告、書籍、信件或照片講述某件事或某段經歷。
benefits.en: Tell of something often appears when a report, book, letter or photograph gives information about an event or experience.

benefits.titleEn: Talk clearly about rules and wrongdoing
benefits.zh: tell somebody off 表示責罵某人；tell on somebody 則表示把某人做錯的事告訴其他人。
benefits.en: Tell somebody off describes scolding someone, while tell on somebody describes reporting what that person has done.

questions.prompt: During the interview, her lack of work experience made the interviewer less likely to choose her.
questions.promptZh: 面試期間，她缺乏工作經驗，令面試官較不願意選擇她。
questions.answer: Her lack of work experience told against her during the interview.
questions.answerZh: 她缺乏工作經驗，這一點在面試期間對她不利。

questions.answerZh: 這篇文章講述一名年輕廚師在倫敦第一年的生活。

questions.promptZh: 媽媽因里奧的房間一片凌亂而生氣地責罵他。

questions.answerZh: 連他們的老師有時也分不出這對雙胞胎。
